title: Rename calc_vat to vat_for with a configurable rate
body: In `pricing/tax.py`, rename `calc_vat(amount)` to `vat_for(amount, rate=0.2)`, which returns `amount * rate` rounded to 2 decimal places. Keep `calc_vat` as a deprecated alias for existing callers: it must return exactly what `vat_for(amount)` returns and emit a `DeprecationWarning` on every call. `vat_for` itself must not warn. Existing behaviour must not change.
